messages:
alina: short agenda  we have launch posts + webinar next week. need final decisions on: canonical strategy for variant landing pages, redirect policy for old blog posts, internal linking plan across launch content, and UTMs -> HubSpot routing. can we lock this today?

sean-seo: high level recs: canonicalize launch pillar to /blog/ai-inference-launch, canonicalize localized variants (eg /blog/ai-inference?region=eu) to the pillar (strip querystrings). set 301 redirects from any legacy slug permutations to the canonical. use internal links from product pages and webinar hub with exact-match anchor text once per page.

emily-marketing: for messaging iteration we plan 3 launch posts (announcements, benchmarks, customer story) + webinar hub. can we add UTM schema now so analytics/ops can route leads by funnel?

nate-analytics: UTM mapping proposal: utm_source=email|paid|organic|partner; utm_medium=newsletter|cpc|social; utm_campaign=launch_v1|launch_v2|benchmark_run; utm_content=creative_id. HubSpot mapping: source->hs_source, medium->hs_medium, campaign->hs_campaign, content->hs_content. capture landing_page (location.pathname) and landing_full (location.href) for dedupe.

olive-eng: implementation notes: we can add server-side canonical header + meta tag. for redirects we'll add entries to static redirect table (Netlify/hardcoded) or our redirect service. example rule for Netlify-like redirect file:

```
/blog/ai-inference-launch-old   /blog/ai-inference-launch  301!
```

olive-eng: for querystring variants we'll return `Link: <https://redwood.com/blog/ai-inference-launch>; rel="canonical"` header and `X-Robots-Tag: noindex,follow` for pages that only exist as campaign thank-yous.

sean-seo: internal linking guidelines: from product pages use anchor "AI inference at scale" -> pillar post, from docs use contextual links (no footer sitewide exact-match). avoid keyword stuffing. also add rel="sponsored" on paid partner outbound links.

emily-marketing: inbound routing rules for HubSpot: if utm_campaign contains "launch" -> lifecycle stage=opportunity (after webinar attendance), else lifecycle=lead. we'll keep a mapping sheet. i'll post a google sheet link shortly.

alina: can someone paste minimal GTM/dataLayer + a server header example we can hand to eng? also note legal needs consent checks for EU.

nate-analytics: GTM/dataLayer snippet (to be fired on the landing + thanks pages):

```
<script>
(function(){
  function param(k){var m=new RegExp('[?&]'+k+'=([^&]*)').exec(location.search);return m?decodeURIComponent(m[1]):''}
  window.dataLayer=window.dataLayer||[];
  dataLayer.push({
    event:'redwood_launch_entry',
    utm_source:param('utm_source'),
    utm_medium:param('utm_medium'),
    utm_campaign:param('utm_campaign'),
    utm_content:param('utm_content'),
    landing_page:location.pathname,
    landing_full:location.href
  });
})();
</script>
```

olive-eng: server header example (for applb / edge):

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Link: <https://redwood.com/blog/ai-inference-launch>; rel="canonical"
X-Robots-Tag: noindex,follow
```

sean-seo: redirect checklist: 1) list legacy slugs 2) verify 301 rules 3) run crawl to ensure no soft-404s 4) update internal links 5) submit sitemap. i'll volunteer to run the prelaunch crawl.

emily-marketing: on internal linking: when publishing, add a nav callout to the webinar hub and include CTA in the announcement post (first paragraph). keep anchor variation to 2 patterns max.

legal-bot: reminder: in EU, only push personal identifiers to HubSpot after consent. mark tests with EU consent=true in QA.

alina: ok action items: emily to post UTM mapping sheet, olive to add canonical header + redirect entries, nate to provide GTM container snippet and hubspot property mapping, sean to run crawl prelaunch and post-redirect check, legal-bot to provide consent check steps. target: all done by EOD tomorrow. blocking issues?

seo-bot: automated scan note: ensure we don't have multiple indexable pages with same body + different querystrings. will flag duplicates on the crawl.

sean-seo: one more tiny SEO detail: add JSON-LD BreadcrumbList on blog pillar and article pages to help SERP display. example snippet for pillar->post: see doc in /docs/seo-snippets.

emily-marketing: adding to checklist now. thanks team :rocket:
